fonts.role: Korean neon display — the hanging signs and poem

texture: No raster imagery — every surface is CSS. Buildings are flat-top gradient blocks inset with shadow; lit windows are 4×5px amber/cyan/magenta specks that blink on mutually-prime periods. The puddle is a dark gradient with two blurred radial reflections (magenta + cyan) flipped vertically and drifted by pointer. The retrowave sun is a circular magenta→amber→purple gradient masked into horizontal slats; the floor is a perspective-rotated cyan+magenta grid scrolling toward the viewer. Rain is a 105° repeating-linear-gradient; scanlines are a 2px horizontal repeat; a radial vignette closes the edges. Pure code.

motion.name: neon-flicker
motion.value: 3.2s / 4.1s / 5.7s mutually-prime keyframes — signs and the title glow on staggered, never-synchronized periods so the street reads alive
motion.used: title glow, hanging signs, ASCII signage

motion.name: window-blink
motion.value: 5.7s opacity 0.7↔0.25 — scattered lit windows fading independently

motion.name: rain-fall
motion.value: 0.6s linear infinite, 105° diagonal repeating gradient — the rain never stops

motion.name: grid-scroll
motion.value: 4s linear infinite, perspective floor scrolling toward viewer

motion.name: pointer-parallax
motion.value: normalized pointer (-0.5→0.5) → --neon-px/--neon-py; buildings, hanging signs, puddle reflections drift at depths 8–20px
